transcript: Speaker A (Human): My English is not good and I have no one to practice with. Speaker B (AI): I am Vani, your SpeakEasy AI tutor. You can practice with me, speak in Hindi, and get instant feedback on grammar and pronunciation. Speaker A: Is it expensive? Speaker B: No, it is 7x cheaper than normal classes and trusted by over 1 crore users. Speaker A: I don't have much time. Speaker B: Just 15-20 minutes daily is enough. Install the app now to see improvement in 15 days. Speaker C: Download SpeakEasy now to speak fluent English.
on_screen_text: On-screen captions translate the conversation about practicing English with SpeakEasy AI. Key text: 'SpeakEasy AI', 'Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy', 'Install Now', 'GET IT ON Google Play'.
summary: A split-screen ad features a homemaker talking to an AI tutor named Vani on the SpeakEasy app. The AI tutor highlights features like instant feedback, affordability, and quick daily practice to build confidence. The ad ends with a call to download the app on Google Play.
